note: Test-id ledger for GF-1 (golden floor for the core events and outcome kinds; owner ruling 2026-10-15), built against base 115b7b573 (main after the engine-split 1e merge, #960). Ids are relative to each collection ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --before <before-matrix.json>=<base>/tools/matrix --before <before-scripts.json>=<base> --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --after <after-matrix.json>=tools/matrix --after <after-scripts.json>=. --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f>` (--isolate on BOTH sides): the WHOLE engine package from the engine directory, and scripts/__tests__ and tools/matrix/__tests__ from the repo root with the engine vitest binary (--exclude **/strip-types-loadable.test.ts for the matrix collection). GF-1 plus its review fixes add 81 tests and change no existing test id: 42 in the new src/testkit/golden-floor.test.ts, 17 in the new src/testkit/golden-floor-overlay.test.ts, 17 in the new src/testkit/golden-floor-streams.test.ts, 2 in the new src/testkit/golden-floor-voids.test.ts, and 3 in src/testkit/golden-forfeit-migration.test.ts. Existing tests whose BODY changed under their unchanged title: golden-slim.test.ts (extendCorpus appends in the canonical slim form: drops the last generator stream, not the last stream). apps/web tests that read the corpora (timeline.test.ts, outcome-readers.test.ts, and public-player-matches.test.ts, whose golden sweep now carries each void's target and asserts zero refused prefixes) change no id and are outside this ledger's roots. Whole-run parity: before-only 0, after-only 81, both 11437 (engine 5987 + matrix 5222 + scripts 228 before; engine 6068 + matrix 5222 + scripts 228 after), unaccounted 0. The N1 round (3 tests added, 1 retitled, both in golden-floor-overlay.test.ts; two timeouts changed in place) was re-verified at file level: the after-side ids of the five GF-1 test files equal this ledger's entries for them plus the 8 pre-existing golden-forfeit-migration tests, and no other test file changed.
